sum: Inno Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in business of recycled consumer electronic devices in the United States. The company sources and purchases pre-owned consumer electronic devices, such as smartphones and tablets from suppliers and sells the electronic devices to wholesalers. It is also involved in remodel buildings using framing steel products; and AI tech research and consulting activities. Inno Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
